# Appearance assets

The user supplied the Andy Bold, VCR OSD Mono and Bebas Neue files, a disc image for EVA Matisse, and the Terraria Overworld and Earthmover pictures for KainCheck theme presets.

The disc image contains an installer. No installer was run. EVA Matisse Classic was read from the font already installed on the user’s computer. The original files in Downloads and Windows Fonts remain unchanged.

WOFF2 copies include Latin/extended-Latin, punctuation and currency characters used by the English/Filipino app, retaining font name/copyright metadata. Other characters use system fallback fonts. Backgrounds are web copies of the supplied pictures. The Terraria image uses lossless WebP. Bebas Neue’s supplied OFL text is retained here. Asset source names and game names identify the user’s requested visual presets; no general license or endorsement is asserted for the other supplied assets.
